name: Prothipendyl
summary: Prothipendyl (brand names Dominal, Timovan, Tolnate), also known as azapromazine or phrenotropin, is an anxiolytic, antiemetic, and antihistamine of the azaphenothiazine group which is marketed in Europe and is used to treat anxiety and agitation in psychotic syndromes. It differs from promazine only by the replacement of one carbon atom with a nitrogen atom in the tricyclic ring system.

pharmacology.text: Prothipendyl is said to not possess antipsychotic effects, and in accordance, appears to be a weaker dopamine receptor antagonist than other phenothiazines.

uses.text: Prothipendyl (brand names Dominal, Timovan, Tolnate), also known as azapromazine or phrenotropin, is an anxiolytic, antiemetic, and antihistamine of the azaphenothiazine group which is marketed in Europe and is used to treat anxiety and agitation in psychotic syndromes.

sideEffects.en: Common effects include drowsiness, dry mouth, dizziness and low blood pressure on standing. Related phenothiazine drugs can also cause movement problems such as stiffness and restlessness.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用包括嗜睡、口乾、頭暈和起身時血壓偏低。相關的啡噻嗪類藥物也可能引起肌肉僵硬和坐立不安等動作問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用包括嗜睡、口干、头晕和起身时血压偏低。相关的啡噻嗪类药物也可能引起肌肉僵硬和坐立不安等动作问题。

fact.en: Prothipendyl is promazine with one carbon atom in its ring system swapped for nitrogen, which is why it is also called azapromazine.
fact.zh: Prothipendyl 是把丙嗪環系統中的一個碳原子換成氮原子，因此也稱為 azapromazine。
fact.zhHans: Prothipendyl 是把丙嗪环系统中的一个碳原子换成氮原子，因此也称为 azapromazine。
